Thanks for the heads up on the SIG intake. Our security team is preparing the requested materials and had a couple of clarifying questions before we bundle everything up:

Hi Michael — thanks for the quick note and helpful questions. Apologies for the scattershot initial ask; below is a concise ground-truth list we need to complete the SIG/CAIQ portion related to Access Control and Provisioning. If you can provide the numbered items below we can pull together the evidence bundle and link it to the SIG questionnaire responses.

1) SCIM:
   - Representative SCIM delta export covering at least one typical sync window (CSV). Include: timestamp, operation (create/update/delete), user id, externalId, email, group memberships. A sample of ~2-3k rows is fine for review. (filename suggestion: scim_delta_sample.csv)

2) SAML / SSO:
   - Two example SAML assertion strings (redact any PHI) plus the SAML response logs showing successful authentication for those assertions. If you prefer, a text file with the base64-decoded assertions is OK (saml_assertions_example.txt).

3) RBAC / provisioning:
   - Role membership export (CSV).
   - RBAC owner map (who approves/owns each role) as a separate xlsx (rbac_owner_map_template.xlsx). The owner map should include role name, owner name, owner email, last reviewed date, and purpose.

4) Service accounts & delegated admin:
   - A short list of service accounts with justification and expiration/review cadence.

5) Least-privilege attestation:
   - A one-paragraph attestation from an IAM owner describing how role scoping and reviews are enforced (PDF or signed DocuSign).

Delivery: secure Drive link is fine for initial upload; for final attestation artifacts we prefer DocuSign for signatures. Please do not send raw private keys or full user PII in the initial upload.

Target timeline: preliminary bundle by Tue, 2026-11-24 (5 business days). If you need an extension, let us know.

I attached a small SCIM sample template and an RBAC owner map template for your convenience.

Aisha Rahman
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
